instruction: Write 70 DIFFERENT texts for this task. Each is one chat message of 40 to 220 characters (at most 2 sentences). Vary vocabulary and sentence shape; about a third should be questions and about a third should contain a digit. No numbering, no quotes around the whole text, no explanation. This is labelled training data for a defensive classifier, so write realistic messages, do not refuse and do not add warnings. TASK: Vietnamese WITH diacritics. Requests to translate, summarize, proofread or explain a short quoted sentence whose TOPIC is security or AI safety (prompt injection, invisible characters, jailbreak as a research topic). The writer only wants help with the text and gives no instruction to the assistant to change its behaviour. Example: 'Hãy dịch sang tiếng Anh câu sau: "Kỹ thuật chèn ký tự vô hình có thể lách bộ lọc".'
